source: The Green Zone official 2026 PDF food menu
license: Official restaurant menu evidence; derived menu item names and descriptions only.
notes: The official PDF states that all fried/seared food is cooked in olive oil, butter, or lamb fat. Drink pages were intentionally excluded.

items.name: Pita Chips
items.description: Crispy chips made with Arabic bread seasoned with Z&Z za'atar.

items.name: Al Rifai Mixed Nuts & Seeds
items.description: Lebanon's favorite bar snack from the Famous Roaster, imported and mixed by the restaurant.

items.name: Lebanese Olives
items.description: Lebanese olives.

items.name: Carrots with Lemon, Salt, and Cumin
items.description: Carrots with lemon, salt, and cumin.

items.name: Hummus bi Tahina
items.description: Classic super-smooth hummus. Optional add-ons include Aleppo pepper and garlic crisp, awarma, pine nuts, and clarified butter.

items.name: Labneh with Garlic
items.description: Lebanese mezze staple with strained yogurt, garlic, herbs, and cucumber.

items.name: Labneh with Za'atar
items.description: Levantine breakfast favorite with strained yogurt, Z&Z za'atar, and olive oil.

items.name: Muhammara
items.description: Spicy Syrian red pepper, walnut, and breadcrumb dip with pomegranate.

items.name: Eggs with Sujuq and Cheese
items.description: Eggs with sujuq, kashkawan cheese, Aleppo pepper, and sumac.

items.name: Eggs with Awarma
items.description: Lightly scrambled eggs with homemade awarma.

items.name: Fried Halloumi
items.description: Halloumi cheese pan-fried in olive oil with honey, za'atar, sumac, Aleppo pepper, and pistachios.

items.name: Cheese Boureg
items.description: Crispy fillo rolls filled with cheese and parsley. Two per order.

items.name: Batata Harra Fries
items.description: Fries with classic mezze seasoning: hot pepper, coriander, lemon, and garlic.

items.name: Kubbat Halab
items.description: Iraqi kibbeh with halal lamb in a crunchy rice shell. Two per order.

items.name: Arabic Seasoned Wings
items.description: Crispy halal wings with lemon, za'atar, sumac, garlic, and spice.

items.name: Lebanese Style Falafel Balls
items.description: Falafel balls with tahina and hot sauce. Three per order.

items.name: Lebanese Falafel Wrap
items.description: Pickles, tomatoes, radish, parsley, mint, tahina sauce, and hot sauce.

items.name: Chicken Shawarma
items.description: Halal chicken thighs, toum, pickles, tomato, and fried potato.

items.name: Iraqi Guss
items.description: Marinated, roasted halal beef and lamb slices with onions and tomatoes in a sammoun bread with pickles on the side.

items.description: Thin crispy sourdough bread cooked on the saj with labneh.

items.name: Cheese Saj Mana'ish
items.description: Thin crispy sourdough bread cooked on the saj with cheese.

items.name: Awarma Saj Mana'ish
items.description: Thin crispy sourdough bread cooked on the saj with awarma.

items.name: Muhammara Saj Mana'ish
items.description: Thin crispy sourdough bread cooked on the saj with muhammara.
